resources.string: Pocket-dial protection with zero idle battery cost. NoPoDial sleeps until a call actually happens, then checks whether your phone dialed from a pocket and texts the other side so they don\'t call back.
Sorry — that was an accidental pocket dial. Nothing\'s wrong, no need to call back!
Max call length to treat as a pocket dial (seconds)
✗ Missing permissions: phone state, call log, and SMS are required

How it stays battery-friendly: there is no background service and no always-on sensor. Android wakes NoPoDial only when call state changes. The proximity sensor is read exactly once, at the instant a call starts, then released.
